data.comment:
Extraction verification complete — core repo does NOT yet build standalone. AC2-AC4 remain unmet pending a producer decision on the cross-boundary fixes below.

Method: extracted the real core repo via scripts/extract-repos.sh --target core (git-filter-repo) and ran npx tsc --noEmit. Evidence is concrete and the coupling set is small and enumerable.

Cross-boundary couplings found (core code that imports game code):

(A) src/ui/debug/ — 2 files import Main Street:
  src/ui/debug/MarketCardCheatOverlay.ts  -> MainStreetCards, MainStreetMarket, MainStreetState
  src/ui/debug/StaffApplicantCheatOverlay.ts -> MainStreetEngine, MainStreetState
  Consumed only by example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetScene.ts (via src/ui/debug/index.ts). These are Main-Street cheat tools living in core.

(B) src/balance-cards/ — 5 files import Main Street:
  scripts/balance/{baseline-blocks,drift-report}.ts and scripts/balance/engine/{baseline,card-metrics,global-metrics}.ts -> MainStreetMonteCarlo, MainStreetDifficulty

(C) scripts/ — many game-specific generators:
  generate-fixture-transcript.ts (golf), generate-feudalism-fixture-transcript.ts, generate-lc-fixture-transcript.ts, generate-sushi-go-fixture-transcript.ts, generate-main-street-*.{ts,mjs}, monte-carlo.ts, playtest-scenarios.ts, save-load-smoke.ts, run-balance-cards.ts, generate-card-csv.ts, design-12-tiers.py, create-dummy-main-street-screenshot.ts, scripts/adapters/*ReplayAdapter.ts

(D) example-games/gym — 1 file:
  example-games/gym/GymCardIndex.ts -> MainStreetCards, MainStreetFormatting, MainStreetDifficulty (Gym using a game's modules)

(E) tests — several core-owned suites reference games:
  tests/ui/screen-layout-schema.test.ts -> example-games/main-street/layouts/main-street.layout.json
  tests/gym/GymCardIndex.test.ts, tests/helpers/main-street-tutorial-e2e.ts, tests/ui/{MainStreetMigration,hud-layer-contract,CardGameSceneUndoRedoPositions}.browser.test.ts, tests/ui/HelpPanel*.test.ts, tests/core-engine/I18n.test.ts, tests/rule-engine/{EconomyLedger,LegalityResult}.test.ts

Also fixed as part of this work: the smoke/dev Vitest project include lists hardcoded game test paths, which makes a core-only checkout fail with 'no test files found'. vite.config.ts now filters those lists through selectedGameIds() so a core-only checkout runs only core + Gym (verified: smoke profile = 3 files / 29 tests, unit profile = 403 files).

Worktree hygiene note: an earlier layout edit of mine landed in the main checkout by mistake (scripts/configs/repo-layout.json). It was copied into the worktree and the main checkout restored with git checkout --; main checkout is clean.

Blocking decision needed (see parent epic comment).
